directOffers.note: Official evo ad-hoc page states 0.49 EUR/kWh gross for AC charging in the evo network, without registration, app, charging card, contract or basic fee. No blocking fee currently applies for QR/card-terminal ad-hoc charging.

Official evo ad-hoc page states 0.49 EUR/kWh gross for HPC charging in the evo network, with up to 400 kW and direct card/mobile-wallet payment available at HPC terminals. No blocking fee currently applies for ad-hoc charging.

roamingPolicy: The 0.49 EUR/kWh price applies only to ad-hoc QR/card-terminal payment in the physical evo charging network. Roaming app or charging-card prices may differ and must remain separate eMSP offers without replacing physical CPO identity.
